answer: Each identity binds one secure-enclave key with a manufacturer certificate and locks 15 POA for 90 days; it signs a fresh epoch nonce no copy can forge. Duplicate fingerprints are rejected and both deposits slashed, so one chip cannot serve many names. A juniper on one ledge holds a single foothold, while a mesa of clones needs a chip per peak. Each extra fake costs another device plus 15 POA, so 100 fakes cost 100 devices and 1500 POA, rising by one device per fake. Fingerprints, signatures, and slashes sit on-chain, so any verifier replays the manufacturer chain and checks duplicates.
